objective: Test whether findings transfer across evidence retrieval, narrative understanding, and explanation reliability; avoid tuning to one benchmark
steps: Keep original DetectiveQA study as one axis; pilot MuSiQue and QuALITY as complementary axes, not pooled replacement data.
Resolve MuSiQue original-file provenance and review entity bridges. Keep DetectBench outside formal scoring until quality criteria and annotations are reviewed.
Define dataset-specific input adapters and metrics on development material. Retain source paragraph IDs. Never put answers, supporting flags or decompositions into ordinary prompts.
Two students independently assess each review item with a third adjudicating disagreements; rotate roles, blind system identity/output correctness where possible, and record real contributions.
Freeze common method and dataset adapters before final comparisons. When claiming transfer, do not retune method on the target dataset's final scores.

Construct future holdouts by novel/article and variants, check shared atomic questions/documents for multi-hop data. Candidate audit samples and previously exposed DetectiveQA test samples must be disclosed and excluded from any claim of fresh blind validation.

Report each dataset separately, with paired method differences, uncertainty and per-document clustering where applicable. Report disagreements and full denominators; do not remove questions merely because a model misses them.
Measure runtime, token counts, actual API cost and evidence coverage where labels support it. Verify pricing and total projected cost before expanding paid runs within the recorded CNY100-300 budget.

detectiveqa: annotated clue coverage under existing cutoff rules
human evidence sufficiency and explanation validity
quality: human evidence sufficiency and alternative-option support
optional_reliability_direction: coverage versus accuracy when abstention is allowed
closed-book or reduced-evidence controls where feasible

comparability_limits: Accuracy and token F1 measure different outputs and must not be indiscriminately averaged.
English supplemental datasets versus Chinese DetectiveQA change language, domain and length together; score differences do not isolate any one cause.

MuSiQue has 17-20 supplied paragraphs in the local dev file. A 50-candidate condition requires separately defined corpus construction; do not silently manufacture an equivalent to the original 50-chunk experiment.
Answer agreement is not proof of valid reasoning. LLM judges are aids, not human gold annotations.
All proposed controls, formal model runs, student ratings, split changes and cost estimates remain unperformed in this audit.
